newsitem.title: UK: Palm oil prices drift on quiet European market.
newsitem.headline: Palm oil prices drift on quiet European market.

text.p: Palm oil prices were drifting lower in Europe on Thursday but any movement was small on a market seeking fresh direction.
Malaysian palm oil export data that was released by local cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) did nothing to help the market.
SGS said it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for October 1-15 at 374,988 tonnes against 310,058 tonnes in September 1-15.
Some traders were not impressed by the figures while others said they were about in line with market expectations.
Palm oil was $2.50 down across-the-board in thin activity after crude palm oil fetched $522.50 a tonne cif for Nov and Jan/Mar
Among refined oil olein traded at $526 and $525 for full Nov and at $522.50 for dated material. Dec fetched $520 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Palm stearin was $5 to $2.50 lower after Nov traded at $373 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Lauric oils were mixed with coconut oil $5 to $2.50 down and palmkernel oil $5 to $10 up, but buyers were not chasing the sellers in either markets.
Dutch soy oil sellers were 0.50 guilders down folloiwng the lower close in Chicago on Wednesday while rape oil was unchanged.
